Sage on Sarr contract, Mateta's fitness and Glasner's return with Forest

Published

9 October 2026

Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage has been speaking to the media before Sunday's Premier League game against Nottingham Forest at Selhurst Park (14:00 BST).

Here are the key lines from his news conference:

Sage confirmed last season's top scorer Ismaila Sarr is in contention to start on Sunday, having played just eight minutes for the Eagles so far this campaign:
